title: Rules and Site-Care Statement Terms (Community Rules & Site Care)
content:
The Community Rules & Site Care statement is governed by the terms below on every plan, from the Self-Maintained Site to the Complete Site Care Plan.

| Term | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Late fee on unpaid rules and site-care charges | none — no late fee is charged |
| Days a plan fee may remain unpaid after its due day before plan services are suspended | 60 days |
| Calendar days after a charge is posted within which the resident may appeal it | 14 days |
| Calendar days after an appeal is received within which the community manager decides it | 10 days |
| Rounding applied to every computed charge | half up to the cent |

## Channels through which rules and site-care charges are paid

| Channel | How the payment arrives |
|---|---|
| Autopay | a recurring automatic bank draft the resident has authorised |
| Resident portal, bank account | from a checking or savings account through the resident portal |
| Resident portal, card | by debit or credit card through the resident portal |
| Money order | handed in at the community office |
| Cashier's check | handed in at the community office |
| Personal check | handed in at the community office |

## Reading the terms

- **Hypothetical illustration.** A computed amount of $41.125 is stated as $41.13, and $41.124 as $41.12, under half-up rounding to the cent.
- **Hypothetical illustration.** A plan fee unpaid 60 days after its due day has reached the suspension figure; at 59 days it has not.
- The absence of a late fee applies to every rules and site-care charge on the statement.
